proposal.description: Exact provenance binds MediaDive1188 to DSMZ1344 Taps 17.4 g. The original recipe and manufacturer T5130/108320 nomenclature establish the conventional TAPS buffer name, N-[tris(hydroxymethyl)methyl]-3-aminopropanesulfonic acid (CHEBI:191055, CAS29915-38-6). Represent that free-buffer identity separately from CAS91000-53-2 sodium salt and from the automatically matched Tyr-Arg-Phe-Sar peptide. No Sigma purchase, lot assay or sodium salt is inferred from pH8.3. The existing sodium-salt alias rejection remains valid. Specific supplier/catalogue/lot and measured supplied purity are unknown; these are not prerequisites for the conventional free-buffer identity proposal. Source metadata repair and whole-owner/export acceptance remain held.

observation: The complete selected OLS CHEBI191055 response contains its systematic primary label and only a long systematic synonym (one exact, one related); neither synonym list nor primary label contains TAPS. The Sigma T5130/108320 primary pages establish TAPS as the common manufacturer name for that systematic chemical and CAS29915-38-6. That supports the substantive free-buffer identity but does not establish an ontology-synonym lookup. The current proposal therefore overstates its recorded grounding method.
recommended_action: Preserve the supported free-buffer identity, salt/peptide distinctions, source1188 and all holds. In a bounded successor record the actual evidenced resolution method. CAS_RN_LOOKUP is appropriate only if a unique CAS-to-ontology lookup is explicitly verified and recorded; do not mechanically choose it, relabel as human curation, or alter the target to satisfy a grade. Append honest history and obtain exact-byte independent re-review.
